steps.caption: Mirror mode is one setting, plus an optional Matrix admin token so people can claim their account.
In Element the message comes from @admin — a normal account with her name and portrait.
The member list shows each Mattermost person as @username on the homeserver, not an @_mattermost_ ghost.
The bridge panel shows Carol her Matrix account and a button to claim it.
Claiming from the panel hands over the account and shows the one-time password once.
`/matrix claim` hands Carol her Matrix account, with a one-time password to sign in.
Carol signs in to Element with her claimed account and writes in the room.
In Mattermost the message is her own post, not a remote lookalike. Nothing is duplicated.
`/matrix status` reports mirror mode, how many accounts exist and how many are claimed.
